name: driver-acp
description: Any agent that speaks the Agent Client Protocol (ACP) as a chat in the agent panel, started in the app folder: DeepSeek Harness (dsh --profile acp) is the first preset, other ACP agents are added by config. Development only; needs the agent panel; opt-in with acrylblends add driver-acp.
mount: register it in src/app.ts ('driver-acp': driverAcp) and add a row `- id: driver-acp` / `name: driver-acp` to blend.yaml AFTER the agent-panel row; with dsh on the PATH the panel offers acp:dsh
